segments.text: THis Book of Articles before rehearſed, is again approved, and allowed to be holden & executed within the Realm, by the Aſſent and Conſent of our Sovereign Lady ELIZABETH, by the Grace of God, of England, France, and Ireland Queen, Defender of the Faith, &c. Which Articles were deliberately read, and Confirmed again by the Subſcription of the Hand of the Archbiſhop & Biſhops of the Ʋpper Houſe, and by the Subſcription of the whole Clergy of the Nether Houſe in their Convocation, in the Year of our Lord, 1571,
